title: Todd Monken addresses the Shilo Sanders comments about Mary Kay Cabot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken addresses the Shilo Sanders comments about Mary Kay Cabot
sources.description: Shilo Sanders, the brother of Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders, created a stir in recent days by making a misogynistic remark about longtime Browns reporter Mary Kay Cabot, and by following it not with an apology but an explanation that only reinforced his misguided views.
